what: Reference miniSEED records written by libmseed, the reference C implementation of the format (EarthScope), used by the acceptance suite to prove this program's Steim1/Steim2 decoder against an independent writer.

libmseed_steim2_512.mseed.note: the first 900 samples of the same series

writer: pymseed 1.0.1 (libmseed 3.5.4), MS3TraceList.generate(format_version=2), written 2026-10-02 on the maintainer's machine
channel: TX.PB01.00.HHZ at 100 Hz from 2024-03-01T12:34:56.1234Z (the 4096-byte files); XX.SYN..HHZ at 50 Hz from 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z (the 512-byte file). The station code is a label on synthetic samples; no TexNet data is in these files.

samples.recipe: numpy.random.default_rng(11); differences = concatenate(integers(-7,8,300), integers(-15,16,300), integers(-31,32,300), integers(-127,128,200), integers(-511,512,200), integers(-16383,16384,100), [2**28, -2**28, 2**29-1, -(2**29)], integers(-3,4,500)); samples = cumsum(differences) as int32. The sequence exercises every Steim2 packing form (4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 15 and 30-bit differences) and Steim1's three. The sha256 above is the authority; the recipe documents how it was made.
